user.title: CalDAV account
user.description: Enter the CalDAV server URL and account credentials.

data_description.url: The address of your CalDAV server. On most servers the bare host name is enough.
data_description.verify_ssl: Leave this on unless you know why not. Off, anyone between Home Assistant and the server can read the password.
data_description.ca_bundle: Optional. Verify the server against this file instead of the system store.
data_description.client_cert: Optional. Identifies Home Assistant to servers that ask for a certificate.
data_description.client_key: Optional. The private key belonging to that certificate.

reconfigure.title: Change the CalDAV connection
reconfigure.description: Update the server URL or the TLS settings. The account itself stays as it is.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate CalDAV
reauth_confirm.description: The password for {username} is no longer accepted. Enter the current one.

abort.already_in_progress: Configuration flow is already in progress

data_description.scan_interval: How often to look for changes made outside Home Assistant.
data_description.timeout: How long to wait for the server to answer a single request.
data_description.days: How far ahead to look when picking the upcoming event.
data_description.include_all_day: Whether an all-day event can become the upcoming event.
data_description.read_only: Hides the create, edit and delete controls.

calendar.title: Settings for {calendar}
calendar.description: These replace the account settings for {calendar} alone.

data_description.days: How far ahead to look when picking the upcoming event.
data_description.include_all_day: Whether an all-day event can become the upcoming event.
data_description.read_only: Hides the create, edit and delete controls.
data_description.reset: Discards everything set here and follows the account again.

error.no_calendars: Pick at least one calendar; an account with none has no entities at all.

builtin_caldav_conflict.title: The built-in CalDAV integration serves the same account
builtin_caldav_conflict.description: The account {account} is also set up in the built-in CalDAV integration, so every calendar and to-do list shows up twice. Remove one of the two.

no_sync_collection.title: The server cannot report what changed
no_sync_collection.description: The server behind {account} does not support the sync-collection report (RFC 6578), so every poll has to fetch the whole window instead of only what changed. Everything works, it just costs more. A longer poll interval keeps the load down.

allday_timed_switch.message: A recurring event cannot be switched between all-day and timed.

ambiguous_calendar.message: This account has more than one calendar called {name}; rename one of them first.

bad_recurrence_id.message: {value} is not a date or a date and time.

document_empty.message: The document has no event and no to-do item in it.

document_no_uid.message: The document has a component without a UID.

end_before_start.message: The end is before the start.

etag_conflict.message: This item changed on the server since Home Assistant last read it. Reload the calendar and make the edit again.

invalid_rrule.message: The recurrence rule is not valid: {reason}

mixed_time_types.message: Give a start and an end of the same kind: two dates for an all-day event, or two date-and-times.

no_event_in_object.message: The calendar object holds no event.

no_scheduling.message: This server does not do CalDAV scheduling, so invitations cannot be answered from here.

no_start_in_object.message: This event has no start date, so it cannot be changed here.

no_todo_in_object.message: This item is not stored as a to-do, so it cannot be changed here.

not_an_attendee.message: This event does not list your account as an attendee.

not_found.message: That item is no longer on the server.

not_recurring.message: This event is not a recurring series.

occurrence_not_found.message: This series has no occurrence on {recurrence_id}.

ranged_override.message: This series holds an exception that applies from one occurrence onwards. Edit it in the app that created it.

rdate_split.message: This occurrence was added to the series by hand, and a series cannot be split there.

read_only.message: {name} is read-only, so nothing can be written to it.

rrule_mismatch.message: The new start is not a date the recurrence rule produces.

rrule_too_dense.message: The recurrence rule produces too many occurrences to work through.

same_calendar.message: The event is already on {name}. Pick a different calendar.

server_error.message: The call to the CalDAV server failed ({action}). The log has the details.

unknown_account.message: {config_entry_id} is not a loaded CalDAV account.

unknown_calendar.message: This account has no calendar called {name}.

unknown_target.message: {entity_id} is not a calendar of a loaded CalDAV account.

unknown_todo_item.message: There is no to-do item {uid} on this list.

search_events.name: Search events
search_events.description: Searches the calendar on the server and returns what it matched.

text.name: Text
text.description: The text to look for. Servers match on substrings.

start.name: Start
start.description: Only match events ending after this moment.

end.name: End
end.description: Only match events starting before this moment.

get_free_busy.name: Get free/busy
get_free_busy.description: Returns the busy periods the server reports for a window.

create_event.name: Create event
create_event.description: Creates an event with the properties the standard calendar action cannot set.

start_date.name: Start date
start_date.description: For an all-day event. The first day it covers.

end_date.name: End date
end_date.description: For an all-day event. The day after the last one.

description.name: Description
description.description: The body text of the event.

rrule.name: Recurrence rule
rrule.description: An RFC 5545 RRULE, without the property name.

url.name: URL
url.description: A link that belongs to the event, e.g. a video meeting.

status.name: Status
status.description: Whether the event is confirmed, tentative or cancelled.

transparency.name: Transparency
transparency.description: Whether the event makes you busy or leaves you free.

priority.name: Priority
priority.description: 0 for undefined, 1 is highest, 9 is lowest.

organizer.name: Organizer
organizer.description: The email address organizing the event.

attendees.name: Attendees
attendees.description: Email addresses, or objects with email, name, role, status and rsvp.

alarms.name: Alarms
alarms.description: Reminders, as minutes before the start or objects with minutes_before, action, related and description.

advanced.name: Advanced
advanced.description: Properties beyond a title and a time.

update_event.name: Update event
update_event.description: Changes any subset of an event's properties, the ones the standard calendar action cannot reach included.

uid.name: UID
uid.description: The uid of the event to change.

recurrence_id.name: Recurrence ID
recurrence_id.description: The occurrence to change, for a recurring series.

recurrence_range.name: Recurrence range
recurrence_range.description: THISANDFUTURE to change the occurrence and everything after it.

move_event.name: Move event
move_event.description: Moves an event to another calendar.

uid.name: UID
uid.description: The uid of the event to move.

target_entity_id.name: Target calendar
target_entity_id.description: The calendar to move the event to.

keep_original.name: Keep the original
keep_original.description: Copy instead of move, leaving the event on the source calendar.

import_ics.name: Import iCalendar
import_ics.description: Writes the events and to-do items of an iCalendar document into the calendar.

export_ics.name: Export iCalendar
export_ics.description: Returns one item, or the whole calendar, as an iCalendar document.

uid.name: UID
uid.description: Export only this item, event or to-do. Leave empty for the whole calendar.

set_calendar_color.name: Set calendar color
set_calendar_color.description: Writes the calendar color back to the server, where other clients pick it up.

respond_to_invitation.name: Respond to invitation
respond_to_invitation.description: Answers an event you were invited to. Needs a server that does CalDAV scheduling.

uid.name: UID
uid.description: The uid of the event to answer.

response.name: Response
response.description: Whether to accept, decline or tentatively accept.

create_calendar.name: Create calendar
create_calendar.description: Creates a new calendar on the account.

config_entry_id.name: Account
config_entry_id.description: The CalDAV account to create the calendar on.

name.name: Name
name.description: The display name of the new calendar.

components.name: Components
components.description: What the calendar should hold. Defaults to whatever the server picks.

delete_calendar.name: Delete calendar
delete_calendar.description: Removes a calendar and everything on it from the account.

config_entry_id.name: Account
config_entry_id.description: The CalDAV account the calendar belongs to.

name.name: Name
name.description: The display name of the calendar to remove.
